author: Yadav Bhattarai
review_text: eSewa is a scammer's paradise. The platform is riddled with fraudulent activities, and eSewa does nothing to protect its customers. Despite numerous complaints, they continue to allow scammers to operate openly. Their customer service is non-existent, leaving victims helpless and frustrated. Avoid using eSewa if you value your security and peace of mind.
